Expected Result: Dashboard page loads successfully

Test Case Name: Verify Navigation to Original Mask from Pop-up
Description: Verify that selecting an area in the pop-up navigates to the original mask (Bearbeiten page)

Step Description: Navigate to dashboard and activate Processing Status tile
Expected Result: Pop-up opens with actions listed

Step Description: Select an area/action entry in the pop-up
Expected Result: Selection is registered

Step Description: Verify navigation to the original mask (Bearbeiten page) initiates
Expected Result: User is navigated to the Bearbeiten (Edit) page

Step Description: Verify correct record is displayed in Bearbeiten page
Expected Result: Selected record displayed with updated data in left column and production data in right column

Test Case Name: Verify User Can Continue Release Process - Send for Approval
Description: Verify that after navigation user can continue the release process by sending for approval
Pre-conditions: Writer or Admin user logged in; Saved action selected from pop-up; Navigated to Bearbeiten page
Step Description: From Processing Status pop-up select a saved action
Expected Result: Navigation to Bearbeiten page occurs

Step Description: Verify record is displayed in Bearbeiten page with updated data in left column
Expected Result: Record displayed correctly

Step Description: Verify Send for Approval button is enabled
Expected Result: Send for Approval button is available and enabled

Step Description: Click Send for Approval button
Expected Result: Record is sent for approval successfully

Step Description: Verify status changes to for approval with single orange tick icon
Expected Result: Record shows single orange tick icon

Step Description: Verify record becomes non-editable with message Record not editable
Expected Result: Record is non-editable; message displayed

Test Case Name: Verify User Can Continue Release Process - Approve Record
Description: Verify that user can approve a record after navigation from pop-up
Pre-conditions: Writer or Admin user logged in; For approval action (sent by another user) selected
Step Description: From Processing Status pop-up select a for approval action
Expected Result: Navigation to Bearbeiten page occurs

Step Description: Verify Approve button is enabled for the record
Expected Result: Approve button is available and enabled

Step Description: Click Approve button
Expected Result: Record is approved successfully

Step Description: Verify status changes to approved with green double tick icon
Expected Result: Record shows green double tick icon

Step Description: Verify release user and update timestamp are updated
Expected Result: Timestamp and release user updated; entire tree approved

Test Case Name: Verify User Can Continue Release Process - Reject Record
Description: Verify that user can reject a record after navigation from pop-up
Pre-conditions: Writer or Admin user logged in; For approval action (sent by another user) selected
Step Description: From Processing Status pop-up select a for approval action
Expected Result: Navigation to Bearbeiten page occurs

Step Description: Verify Reject button is enabled for the record
Expected Result: Reject button is available and enabled

Step Description: Enter rejection comments and click Reject button
Expected Result: Record is rejected with comments stored

Step Description: Verify status returns to saved state with save icon
Expected Result: Record shows save icon; becomes editable

Step Description: Verify rejection comments are visible
Expected Result: Rejection comments displayed on record

Step Description: Verify timestamp and change user are updated
Expected Result: Timestamp and change user updated; entire tree rejected
